messages:
kevin: saw a P99 regression after the slotmap allocator change. ~8-12% on paged-attention microbench (long context). rolling back allocator patch gets baseline back. reproducer and perf CSV attached.
maria: can you paste allocator stats and a short perf trace? is this only at seq_len >= 2048 or across lengths?
kevin: repro is seq=4096, batch=2, model=redwood-open-7b, grpc path. quick allocator dump below:
```
allocator: slotmap_v2
total_blocks: 10240
used_blocks: 7890
free_blocks: 2350
fragmented_blocks: 420
avg_frag_percent: 18.3
eviction_ops: 412
pages_pinned: 128
kv_cache_misses: 0.027
```
kevin: microbench numbers: throughput 1.12 tokens/ms vs baseline 1.23 tokens/ms, p99 latency 9.8ms -> 11.0ms
sam: pinging @maria — looks like fragmentation increased contiguous run loss which reduces effective batching packing. my local run shows batch density down ~7% (less coalesced KV hits).
maria: hypothesis: slotmap_v2 first-fit heuristic is leaving many small free fragments between pinned pages. recommend testing two quick things: 1) force pool-backed allocator (pre-allocated superblocks) 2) run a probe that emits contiguous-run-length histogram for block table.
maria: try this env and bench command:
```
export REDWOOD_KV_ALLOC=pool
./bench/paged_attention --model redwood-open-7b --seq 4096 --batch 2 --iters 200 > out.log
```
nora: adding metrics we should emit: `kv.block_run_len.p50`, `kv.block_run_len.p95`, `kv.free_fragment_bytes`. easy to add as counters in the allocator.
infra-bot: CI job started: <https://ci.redwood.ai/job/eng-runtime/4872> (bench/paged-attn, slotmap_v2 pool vs default)
kevin: ran the pool allocator quick test on staging: frag% 18.3 -> 6.1, eviction_ops 412 -> 38
```
allocator: slotmap_pool
total_blocks: 10240
used_blocks: 7945
free_blocks: 2295
fragmented_blocks: 120
avg_frag_percent: 6.1
eviction_ops: 38
pages_pinned: 126
kv_cache_misses: 0.011
```
kevin: perf: throughput 1.20 tokens/ms, p99 9.9ms. so close to baseline.
maria: good signal. if pool lowers fragmentation and restores p99 we should consider switching default to pool or hybrid. also add a microbench that runs long-context rolling tokens (simulate chat) to catch regressions.
sam: I'll add a small regression test in perf-suite to run seq 4096 batch 2 after allocator changes + emit new metrics.
maria: thanks. filing infra ticket and plan: 1) add hist metric for block runs 2) try best-fit/passive compaction of small fragments 3) add regression perf to CI 4) experiment make pool default behind feature flag. filing issue INFR-512.
kevin: ok i'll attach full logs and heap maps to the ticket. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
